translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor settled Yanjing, returned and halted at Yuanyang Marsh, made Zong Han commander-in-chief, and Gao followed the sovereign back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，杲為諳班勃極烈，與宗幹俱治國政。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, Gao was anban bojilie and together with Zong Gan governed the state.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong took the throne, Gao became anban bojilie and governed the state together with Zong Gan.

sentences.zh: 天會三年伐宋，杲領都元帥，居京師。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianhui they campaigned against Song; Gao held the supreme command and remained at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianhui 3 they campaigned against Song. Gao held the supreme command and remained at the capital.

sentences.zh: 宗翰、宗望分道進兵。

translations.literal: Zong Han and Zong Wang advanced by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Han and Zong Wang advanced by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 四年，再伐宋，獲宋二主以歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year they campaigned against Song again and brought back the two Song sovereigns.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year they campaigned against Song again and brought back the two Song emperors captive.

sentences.zh: 天會八年，薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tianhui he died.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianhui 8 he died.

sentences.zh: 皇統三年，追封遼越國王。

translations.literal: In the third year of Huangtong he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liao and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangtong 3 he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liao and Yue.

sentences.zh: 天德二年，酏享太祖廟廷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiande he received posthumous libation in the Grand Ancestor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiande 2 he received posthumous libation in the Grand Ancestor's temple.

sentences.zh: 正隆例封遼王。

translations.literal: By the Zhenglong precedent he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liao.
translations.idiomatic: By the Zhenglong precedent he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liao.

sentences.zh: 大定十五年，諡曰智烈。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Dading his posthumous title was Zhilie.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 15 his posthumous title was Zhilie.

sentences.zh: 子孛吉。

translations.literal: Son: Beiji.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Beiji.

sentences.zh: 宗義本名孛吉，斜也之第九子。

translations.literal: Zongyi's original name was Beiji, the ninth son of Xieye.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyi was born Beiji, the ninth son of Xieye.

sentences.zh: 天德間，為平章政事。

translations.literal: During the Tiande period he was Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tiande period he was vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 海陵已殺太宗子孫，尤忌斜也諸子盛強，欲盡除宗室勳舊大臣。

translations.literal: Hailing had already killed Taizong's descendants and especially feared that Xieye's sons were too powerful; he wished to eliminate all the imperial clan's meritorious old ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing had already killed Taizong's descendants and especially feared that Xieye's sons were too powerful. He wished to eliminate all the imperial clan's meritorious old ministers.

sentences.zh: 是時，左副元帥撒離喝在汴京與撻不野有隙，撻不野女為海陵妃，海陵陰使撻不野圖撒離喝。

translations.literal: At that time the Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Salihua was at Bianjing and had a rift with Tabuye; Tabuye's daughter was Hailing's consort, and Hailing secretly had Tabuye plot against Salihua.
translations.idiomatic: At that time left deputy commander-in-chief Salihua was at Bianjing and had a rift with Tabuye. Tabuye's daughter was Hailing's consort, and Hailing secretly had Tabuye plot against Salihua.

sentences.zh: 於是都元帥府令史遙設迎合風指，詐為撒離喝與其子宗安家書，宗女誤遺宮外，遙設因拾得之，以上變。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Grand Marshal's Office clerk Yaoshe catered to the prevailing wind, forged a letter as if from Salihua to his son Zong'an's household; Zong'an's daughter mistakenly sent it outside, and Yaoshe picked it up and reported the change.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the grand marshal's office clerk Yaoshe catered to the prevailing wind and forged a letter as if from Salihua to his son Zong'an's household. Zong'an's daughter mistakenly sent it outside, and Yaoshe picked it up and reported the change.

sentences.zh: 其書契丹小字，其封題已開。

translations.literal: The letter was in Khitan small script; the address and seal were already opened.
translations.idiomatic: The letter was in Khitan small script. The address and seal were already opened.

sentences.zh: 其中白紙一幅，有白字隱約，狀若經水浸，致字畫可讀者，上有撒離喝手署及某王印。

translations.literal: Within was one sheet of white paper with white characters indistinct, as if soaked in water so the writing could be read: on it were Salihua's own signature and a certain prince's seal.
translations.idiomatic: Within was one sheet of white paper with white characters indistinct, as if soaked in water so the writing could be read. On it were Salihua's own signature and a certain prince's seal.

sentences.zh: 書辭雲：「阿渾，汝安樂否。

translations.literal: The letter said: "Ahun, are you at ease?
translations.idiomatic: The letter said, "Ahun, are you at ease?

sentences.zh: 早晚到闕下。

translations.literal: Come to court early or late.
translations.idiomatic: Come to court early or late.

sentences.zh: 前者走馬來時，曾議論我教汝阿渾平章、謀里野阿渾等處覷事勢再通往來，緩急圖謀，知汝已嘗備細言之。

translations.literal: When the horse came before, we had already discussed my teaching you Ahun as director, Moliye Ahun, and the rest to watch the situation and communicate again as urgency permits, plotting together—you have already reported this in detail, I know.
translations.idiomatic: When the horse came before, we had already discussed my teaching you Ahun as director, Moliye Ahun, and the rest to watch the situation and communicate again as urgency permits, plotting together—you have already reported this in detail, I know.

sentences.zh: 謀里野阿渾所言栎煞是，只殺撻不野則南路無憂慮矣。」

translations.literal: What Moliye Ahun said about killing is right—only kill Tabuye and then the southern route has no worry."
translations.idiomatic: What Moliye Ahun said about killing is right—only kill Tabuye and then the southern route has no worry."

sentences.zh: 詳略互見《撒離喝傳》中。

translations.literal: Details vary and appear in the "Biography of Salihua."
translations.idiomatic: Details vary and appear in the "Biography of Salihua."

sentences.zh: 女直謂子「阿渾」。

translations.literal: The Jurchen call a son "ahun."
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen call a son "ahun."

sentences.zh: 前「阿渾」謂撒離喝子，其子宗安。

translations.literal: The first "ahun" refers to Salihua's son, his son Zong'an.
translations.idiomatic: The first "ahun" refers to Salihua's son, his son Zong'an.

sentences.zh: 後「阿渾平章」指宗義，宗義本宗室子，猶有舊稱。

translations.literal: The later "ahun director" refers to Zongyi; Zongyi was originally an imperial-clan son and still bore the old title.
translations.idiomatic: The later "ahun director" refers to Zongyi. Zongyi was originally an imperial-clan son and still bore the old title.

sentences.zh: 以是殺宗義、謀里野，並殺宗安及太祖妃蕭氏、任王隈喝及魏王斡帶孫活里甲。

translations.literal: For this Zongyi and Moliye were killed, and Zong'an and the Grand Ancestor's consort the Xiao clan, Prince of Assignments Weihai, and Prince of Wei Wolie's grandson Huolijia were also killed.
translations.idiomatic: For this Zongyi and Moliye were killed, and Zong'an and the Grand Ancestor's consort the Xiao clan, Prince of Assignments Weihai, and Prince of Wei's grandson Huolijia were also killed.

sentences.zh: 遙設詐書無活里甲，海陵見其坦率善修飾，惡之。

translations.literal: Yaoshe's forged letter had no Huolijia; Hailing saw he was frank and good at self-adornment and hated him.
translations.idiomatic: Yaoshe's forged letter had no Huolijia. Hailing saw he was frank and good at self-adornment and hated him.

sentences.zh: 大臣以無罪為請，海陵曰：「第殺之，無複言也。」

translations.literal: The great ministers pleaded that he was without crime; Hailing said: "Just kill him, say no more."
translations.idiomatic: The great ministers pleaded that he was without crime. Hailing said, "Just kill him. Say no more."

sentences.zh: 殺斜也子孫百餘人，謀里野子孫二十餘人。

translations.literal: More than a hundred of Xieye's descendants were killed, and more than twenty of Moliye's descendants.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred of Xieye's descendants were killed, and more than twenty of Moliye's descendants.

sentences.zh: 謀里野，景祖孫，謾都訶次子。

translations.literal: Moliye was Jingzu's grandson, second son of Manduhe.
translations.idiomatic: Moliye was Jingzu's grandson, second son of Manduhe.

sentences.zh: 斜也有幼子阿虎里，其妻撻不野女，海陵妃大氏女兄。

translations.literal: Xieye had a young son A Huli whose wife was Tabuye's daughter, elder sister of Hailing's consort the Da clan.
translations.idiomatic: Xieye had a young son A Huli whose wife was Tabuye's daughter, elder sister of Hailing's consort of the Da clan.

sentences.zh: 將殺阿虎里，使者不忍見其面，以衾覆而縊之，當其頤，久不死，及去被再縊之，海陵遣使赦其死，遂得免。

translations.literal: When they were about to kill A Huli the envoy could not bear to see his face, covered him with a quilt and strangled him; when it reached his chin he long did not die, and after the envoy left the cover was removed and he was strangled again; Hailing sent an envoy to pardon his death, and so he was spared.
translations.idiomatic: When they were about to kill A Huli the envoy could not bear to see his face, covered him with a quilt and strangled him. When it reached his chin he long did not die; after the envoy left the cover was removed and he was strangled again. Hailing sent an envoy to pardon his death, and so he was spared.

sentences.zh: 後封為王，授世襲千戶。

translations.literal: Later he was enfeoffed as prince and granted a hereditary thousand-household command.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was enfeoffed as prince and granted a hereditary thousand-household command.

sentences.zh: 大定初，追複宗義官爵，贈特進。

translations.literal: In the early Dading period Zongyi's office and rank were posthumously restored and he was given the extraordinary promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Dading period Zongyi's office and rank were posthumously restored and he was given extraordinary promotion.

sentences.zh: 弟蒲馬、孛論出、阿魯、隈喝並贈龍虎衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Younger brothers Puma, Belunchu, Alu, and Weihai were all posthumously made generals-in-chief of the Dragon-Tiger Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brothers Puma, Belunchu, Alu, and Weihai were all posthumously made generals-in-chief of the Dragon-Tiger Guard.

sentences.zh: 宗幹本名斡本，太祖庶長子。

translations.literal: Zong Gan's original name was Woben, the Grand Ancestor's eldest son by a concubine.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Gan was born Woben, the Grand Ancestor's eldest son by a concubine.

sentences.zh: 太祖伐遼，遼人來禦，遇於境上。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor attacked Liao the Liao came to resist and met him at the border.
translations.idiomatic: When the Grand Ancestor attacked Liao the Liao came to resist and met him at the border.

sentences.zh: 使宗幹率眾先往填塹，士卒畢渡。

translations.literal: He had Zong Gan lead the troops ahead to fill the moat; the soldiers all crossed.
translations.idiomatic: He had Zong Gan lead the troops ahead to fill the moat. The soldiers all crossed.

sentences.zh: 渤海軍馳突而前，左翼七謀克少卻，遂犯中軍。

translations.literal: The Bohai army charged forward; the left wing's seven meng'an slightly gave ground and then struck the central army.
translations.idiomatic: The Bohai army charged forward. The left wing's seven meng'an slightly gave ground and then struck the central army.

sentences.zh: 杲輒出戰，太祖曰：「遇大敵不可易也。」

translations.literal: Gao then went out to fight; the Grand Ancestor said: "Meeting a great enemy one must not be rash."
translations.idiomatic: Gao then went out to fight. The Grand Ancestor said, "Meeting a great enemy one must not be rash."

sentences.zh: 使宗幹止杲。

translations.literal: He had Zong Gan stop Gao.
translations.idiomatic: He had Zong Gan stop Gao.

sentences.zh: 宗幹馳出杲前，控止導騎哲垤之馬，杲乃還。

translations.literal: Zong Gan galloped out before Gao, seized and halted the guiding rider Zhedie's horse, and Gao then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Gan galloped out before Gao, seized and halted the guiding rider Zhedie's horse, and Gao then returned.

sentences.zh: 達魯古城之戰，宗幹以中軍為疑兵。

translations.literal: In the battle of Dalu Ancient City Zong Gan used the central army as a decoy force.
translations.idiomatic: In the battle of Dalu Ancient City Zong Gan used the central army as a decoy force.

sentences.zh: 太祖既攻下黃龍府，即欲取春州。

translations.literal: After the Grand Ancestor had taken Huanglong Prefecture he wished at once to take Chun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After the Grand Ancestor had taken Huanglong Prefecture he wished at once to take Chun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遼主聞黃龍不守，大懼，即自將，籍宗戚豪右少年與四方勇士及能言兵者，皆隸軍中。

translations.literal: The Liao sovereign, hearing Huanglong was not held, was greatly afraid and personally took command, enrolling young men of the imperial clan, powerful families, and warriors from the four directions and those who could speak of military affairs—all were attached to the army.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao sovereign, hearing Huanglong was not held, was greatly afraid and personally took command, enrolling young men of the imperial clan, powerful families, and warriors from the four directions and those who could speak of military affairs—all were attached to the army.

sentences.zh: 宗幹勸太祖毋攻春州，休息士卒。

translations.literal: Zong Gan urged the Grand Ancestor not to attack Chun Prefecture and to rest the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Gan urged the Grand Ancestor not to attack Chun Prefecture and to rest the soldiers.

sentences.zh: 太祖以為然，遂班師。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor thought it right and thereupon withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor thought it right and thereupon withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 宗幹得降人，言春、泰州無守備，可取。

translations.literal: Zong Gan obtained surrendered men who said Chun and Tai prefectures had no garrison and could be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Gan obtained surrendered men who said Chun and Tai prefectures had no garrison and could be taken.

sentences.zh: 於是斜也取春、泰州，宗雄、宗幹等下金山縣。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xieye took Chun and Tai prefectures, and Zong Xiong, Zong Gan, and the others took Jinshan County.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Xieye took Chun and Tai prefectures, and Zong Xiong, Zong Gan, and the others took Jinshan County.

sentences.zh: 宗雄即以兵三千屬宗幹，招集未降諸部。

translations.literal: Zong Xiong then gave three thousand troops to Zong Gan to gather the tribes that had not yet submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Xiong then gave three thousand troops to Zong Gan to gather the tribes that had not yet submitted.

sentences.zh: 宗幹擇土人之材幹者，以詔書諭之。

translations.literal: Zong Gan selected capable men among the natives and instructed them with the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Gan selected capable men among the natives and instructed them with the edict.

sentences.zh: 於是女固、脾室四部及渤海人皆降。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Nügu, Pishi four tribes, and Bohai people all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Nügu, Pishi four tribes, and Bohai people all submitted.

sentences.zh: 太祖克臨潢府，至沃黑河。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestor took Linhuang Prefecture and reached the Wohei River.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor took Linhuang Prefecture and reached the Wohei River.

sentences.zh: 宗幹諫曰：「地遠時暑，士罷馬乏，若深入敵境，糧餫不繼，恐有後艱。」

translations.literal: Zong Gan remonstrated: "The land is distant and the season hot; soldiers are weary and horses exhausted—if we penetrate deep into enemy territory and provisions do not follow, I fear later hardship."
translations.idiomatic: Zong Gan remonstrated, "The land is distant and the season hot. Soldiers are weary and horses exhausted. If we penetrate deep into enemy territory and provisions do not follow, I fear later hardship."

sentences.zh: 上從之，遂班師。

translations.literal: The sovereign followed this and thereupon withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign followed this and thereupon withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 從都統杲取中京。

translations.literal: He followed Commander-in-Chief Gao in taking the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Commander-in-Chief Gao in taking the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 宗翰自北安州移書於杲。

translations.literal: Zong Han sent a letter from Bei'an Prefecture to Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Han sent a letter from Bei'an Prefecture to Gao.

sentences.zh: 是時，希尹獲遼人，知遼主在鴛鴦濼，可襲取之。

translations.literal: At that time Xiyin captured a Liao man who knew the Liao sovereign was at Yuanyang Marsh and could be taken in a surprise attack.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiyin captured a Liao man who knew the Liao sovereign was at Yuanyang Marsh and could be taken in a surprise attack.

sentences.zh: 杲不能決。

translations.literal: Gao could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Gao could not decide.

sentences.zh: 宗翰使再至。

translations.literal: Zong Han's envoy came a second time.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Han's envoy came a second time.

sentences.zh: 宗幹謂杲曰：「移賚勃極烈灼見事機，再使來請，彼必不輕舉。

translations.literal: Zong Gan told Gao: "The transferred bojilie clearly sees the opportunity; he sends envoys twice to request—you must not take it lightly.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Gan told Gao, "The transferred bojilie clearly sees the opportunity. He sends envoys twice to request—you must not take it lightly.

sentences.zh: 且彼已發兵，不可中止，請從其策。」

translations.literal: Moreover he has already sent troops—it cannot be stopped; please follow his plan."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover he has already sent troops. It cannot be stopped. Please follow his plan."

sentences.zh: 再三言之，杲乃報宗翰會奚王嶺。

translations.literal: He spoke again and again, and Gao then replied to Zong Han to meet at the Xi Prince's Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: He spoke again and again until Gao replied to Zong Han to meet at the Xi Prince's Ridge.

sentences.zh: 當時無宗幹，杲終無進兵意。

translations.literal: At that time without Zong Gan, Gao in the end had no intent to advance the army.
translations.idiomatic: Without Zong Gan, Gao in the end had no intent to advance the army.

sentences.zh: 既會軍於羊城濼，杲使宗幹與宗翰以精兵六千襲遼至五院司。

translations.literal: Once the armies met at Yangcheng Marsh, Gao had Zong Gan and Zong Han take six thousand picked troops to strike Liao as far as the Five Yuan Office.
translations.idiomatic: Once the armies met at Yangcheng Marsh, Gao had Zong Gan and Zong Han take six thousand picked troops to strike Liao as far as the Five Yuan Office.

sentences.zh: 遼主已遁去，與遼將耿守忠戰於西京城東四十里。

translations.literal: The Liao sovereign had already fled and fought the Liao general Geng Shouzhong forty li east of the Western Capital city.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao sovereign had already fled and fought the Liao general Geng Shouzhong forty li east of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 守忠敗走。

translations.literal: Shouzhong was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhong was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，宗幹為國論勃極烈，與斜也同輔政。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, Zong Gan was guolun bojilie and together with Xieye assisted in government.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong took the throne, Zong Gan was guolun bojilie and together with Xieye assisted in government.

sentences.zh: 天會三年，獲遼主于應州西余睹穀。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianhui the Liao sovereign was captured west of Yuzhu Valley in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianhui 3 the Liao sovereign was captured west of Yuzhu Valley in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 始議禮制度，正官名，定服色，興庠序，設選舉，治曆明時，皆自宗幹啟之。

translations.literal: They first deliberated ritual systems, rectified official titles, fixed dress colors, established schools, set up selection examinations, regulated the calendar and clarified the seasons—all were initiated by Zong Gan.
translations.idiomatic: They first deliberated ritual systems, rectified official titles, fixed dress colors, established schools, set up selection examinations, and regulated the calendar—all were initiated by Zong Gan.

sentences.zh: 四年，官制行，詔中外。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the official system was implemented and issued an edict inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the official system was implemented and proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 海陵篡立，追諡憲古弘道文昭武烈章孝睿明皇帝，廟號德宗，以故第為興聖宮。

translations.literal: When Hailing usurped the throne he posthumously titled him Emperor Xiangu Hongdao Wenzhao Wulie Zhangxiao Ruiming, temple name Dezong, and made his former residence the Palace of Sagely Birth.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing usurped the throne he posthumously titled him Emperor Xiangu Hongdao Wenzhao Wulie Zhangxiao Ruiming, with temple name Dezong, and made his former residence the Palace of Sagely Birth.

sentences.zh: 大定二年，除去廟號，改諡明肅皇帝。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dading the temple name was removed and the posthumous title changed to Emperor Mingsu.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 2 the temple name was removed and the posthumous title changed to Emperor Mingsu.

sentences.zh: 及海陵廢為庶人，二十二年，皇太子允恭奏，略曰：「追惟熙宗世嫡統緒，海陵無道，弑帝自立，崇正昭穆，削其斷王，俾齒庶人之列。

translations.literal: When Hailing was demoted to commoner status, in the twenty-second year Crown Prince Yonggong memorialized, in gist: "Looking back to Xizong's era and the legitimate line of succession, Hailing was without the Way, murdered the emperor and established himself, exalted the correct and clarified the generations, cut off his enfeoffment as prince, and placed him among commoners.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing was demoted to commoner status, in year 22 Crown Prince Yonggong memorialized, in gist: "Looking back to Xizong's era and the legitimate succession, Hailing was without the Way, murdered the emperor and seized the throne, exalted the correct and clarified the generations, cut off his princely enfeoffment, and placed him among commoners.

sentences.zh: 瘞之閑曠，不封不樹，既已申大義而明至公矣。

translations.literal: Buried in open waste without mound or tree—this already declared the great righteousness and utmost fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Buried in open waste without mound or tree—this already declared great righteousness and utmost fairness.

sentences.zh: 海陵追崇其親，逆配於廟。

translations.literal: Hailing posthumously honored his own kin and improperly paired them in the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing posthumously honored his own kin and improperly paired them in the temple.

sentences.zh: 今海陵既廢為庶人，而明肅猶竊帝尊之名，列廟祧之數。

translations.literal: Now Hailing has been demoted to commoner status yet Mingsu still usurps the title of emperor and ranks among the temple ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Now Hailing has been demoted to commoner status yet Mingsu still usurps the title of emperor and ranks among the temple ancestors.

sentences.zh: 海陵大逆，正名定罪，明肅亦當緣坐。

translations.literal: Hailing's great treason—fixing the name and fixing the crime—Mingsu should also be implicated by association.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing's great treason fixed the name and fixed the crime. Mingsu should also be implicated by association.

sentences.zh: 是時明肅已殂，不與於亂，臣以謂當削去明肅帝號，止從舊爵。

translations.literal: At that time Mingsu was already dead and did not participate in the disorder; your servant thinks the Mingsu imperial title should be cut off and only the old rank retained.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Mingsu was already dead and did not participate in the disorder. Your servant thinks the Mingsu imperial title should be cut off and only the old rank retained.

sentences.zh: 或從太祖諸王有功例，加以官封，明詔中外，俾知大義。」

translations.literal: Or following the precedent of the Grand Ancestor's princes with merit, add official enfeoffment, proclaim clearly inside and outside so all know the great righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: Or following the precedent of the Grand Ancestor's meritorious princes, add official enfeoffment and proclaim clearly throughout the realm so all know the great righteousness."

sentences.zh: 書奏，世宗嘉納，下尚書省議。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; Shizong commended and accepted it and sent it down to the Ministry of Rites for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted. Shizong commended and accepted it and sent it to the Ministry of Rites for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 於是追削明肅帝號，封為皇伯、太師、遼王，諡忠烈，妻子諸孫皆從降。

translations.literal: Thereupon Mingsu's imperial title was posthumously cut off; he was enfeoffed as Imperial Uncle, Grand Mentor, Prince of Liao, posthumous title Zhonglie; wife, sons, and grandsons all followed in reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Mingsu's imperial title was posthumously cut off. He was enfeoffed as imperial uncle, grand mentor, Prince of Liao, posthumous title Zhonglie. Wife, sons, and grandsons all followed in reduction.

sentences.zh: 明昌四年，配享太祖廟廷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Mingchang he received posthumous libation in the Grand Ancestor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Mingchang 4 he received posthumous libation in the Grand Ancestor's temple.

sentences.zh: 子充、亮、兗、襄、袞。

translations.literal: Sons: Chong, Liang, Yan, Xiang, Gun.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Chong, Liang, Yan, Xiang, and Gun.

sentences.zh: 亮，是為海陵庶人。

translations.literal: Liang was the Hailing commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Liang was the man later known as the Hailing commoner.

sentences.zh: 充本名神士懣。

translations.literal: Chong's original name was Shentumen.
translations.idiomatic: Chong was born Shentumen.

sentences.zh: 母李氏，徒單氏以為己子。

translations.literal: Mother Lady Li; the Tudi clan took him as her own son.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Li; the Tudi clan took him as her own son.

sentences.zh: 熙宗初，加光祿大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xizong's reign he was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xizong's reign he was made grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 天眷間，為汴京留守。

translations.literal: During the Tianjuan period he was Bianjing prefect.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianjuan period he was Bianjing prefect.

sentences.zh: 皇統間，封淄國公，為吏部尚書，進封代王，遷同判大宗正事。

translations.literal: During Huangtong he was enfeoffed as Duke of Zi, made Minister of Personnel, advanced to Prince of Dai, and transferred to concurrent Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: During Huangtong he was enfeoffed as Duke of Zi, made minister of personnel, advanced to Prince of Dai, and transferred to concurrent director of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 九年，拜左丞相。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，薨。

translations.literal: That year he died.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died.

sentences.zh: 追封鄭王。

translations.literal: Posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 大定二十二年，追降儀同三司、左丞相。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Dading posthumously reduced to honorary equal to the three excellencies and left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 22 he was posthumously reduced to honorary equal to the three excellencies and left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 子檀奴、元奴、耶補兒、阿里白。

translations.literal: Sons: Tannu, Yuannu, Yebuer, Alibai.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Tannu, Yuannu, Yebuer, and Alibai.

sentences.zh: 檀奴，為歸德軍節度使。

translations.literal: Tannu was military commissioner of Guide Army.
translations.idiomatic: Tannu was military commissioner of the Guide Army.

sentences.zh: 阿里白，定遠大將軍、和魯忽土猛安忽鄰河謀克。

translations.literal: Alibai was general of Dingyuan and hulu tutu meng'an of Hulihu River.
translations.idiomatic: Alibai was general of Dingyuan and hulu tutu meng'an of Hulihu River.

sentences.zh: 海陵弑徒單氏，以充嘗為徒單養子，因並殺檀奴及阿里白。

translations.literal: Hailing murdered the Tudi clan; because Chong had once been Tudi's adopted son, he therefore also killed Tannu and Alibai.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing murdered the Tudi clan. Because Chong had once been Tudi's adopted son, he therefore also killed Tannu and Alibai.

sentences.zh: 元奴、耶補兒逃歸於世宗。

translations.literal: Yuannu and Yebuer fled and returned to Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuannu and Yebuer fled and returned to Shizong.

sentences.zh: 檀奴贈榮祿大夫，阿里白輔國上將軍。

translations.literal: Tannu was posthumously made grand master of glorious emolument; Alibai was made assisting-state general.
translations.idiomatic: Tannu was posthumously made grand master of glorious emolument; Alibai was made assisting-state general.

sentences.zh: 詔有司改葬。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to rebury them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the relevant offices to rebury them.

sentences.zh: 世宗時，元奴為宗正丞；

translations.literal: During Shizong's reign Yuannu was vice director of the imperial clan;
translations.idiomatic: During Shizong's reign Yuannu was vice director of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 耶補兒為鎮國上將軍，後為同知濟南尹事。

translations.literal: Yebuer was general who pacifies the state, later concurrent vice prefect of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Yebuer was general who pacifies the state, later serving concurrently as vice prefect of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 子 永元

translations.literal: Son: Yongyuan
translations.idiomatic: Son: Yongyuan

sentences.zh: 永元字惇禮，本名元奴。

translations.literal: Yongyuan, style name Dunli, original name Yuannu.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan, style name Dunli, was born Yuannu.

sentences.zh: 幼聰敏，日誦千言。

translations.literal: In youth clever and keen, he recited a thousand words daily.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he was clever and keen, reciting a thousand words daily.

sentences.zh: 皇統元年，試宗室子作詩，永元中格。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangtong, when imperial-clan sons were tested in composing poetry, Yongyuan passed.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangtong 1, when imperial-clan sons were tested in composing poetry, Yongyuan passed.

sentences.zh: 善《左氏春秋》，通其大義。

translations.literal: He was skilled in the Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals and grasped its great meaning.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled in the Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn Annals and grasped its great meaning.

sentences.zh: 天德初，授百女山世襲謀克。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiande he was granted the hereditary meng'an of Bainü Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiande he was granted the hereditary meng'an of Bainü Mountain.

sentences.zh: 海陵伐宋，已渡淮，軍士多亡歸而契丹叛，由是疑宗室益甚。

translations.literal: When Hailing attacked Song, after he had crossed the Huai, many soldiers deserted and the Khitan rebelled; because of this he suspected the imperial clan all the more.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing attacked Song, after crossing the Huai many soldiers deserted and the Khitan rebelled. Because of this he suspected the imperial clan all the more.

sentences.zh: 已殺永元弟檀奴、阿里白，永元與弟耶補兒逃匿得免。

translations.literal: He had already killed Yongyuan's younger brothers Tannu and Alibai; Yongyuan and his younger brother Yebuer hid and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: He had already killed Yongyuan's younger brothers Tannu and Alibai. Yongyuan and his younger brother Yebuer hid and escaped.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位于遼陽，與耶補兒俱來歸，上慰勞甚厚。

translations.literal: When Shizong took the throne at Liaoyang both came to submit; the sovereign comforted them very generously.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong took the throne at Liaoyang both came to submit. The sovereign comforted them very generously.

sentences.zh: 授宗正丞，改符寶郎，為灤州刺史。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice director of the imperial clan, then changed to keeper of the seals, and made prefect of Luan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director of the imperial clan, then keeper of the seals, and made prefect of Luan.

sentences.zh: 授世襲猛安，乞以謀克與耶補兒，詔許之。

translations.literal: He was granted a hereditary meng'an and begged to give the meng'an to Yebuer; the edict permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted a hereditary meng'an and begged to give the meng'an to Yebuer. The edict permitted it.

sentences.zh: 轉棣州防禦使、泰甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to defense commissioner of Di Prefecture and military commissioner of Taining Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to defense commissioner of Di Prefecture and military commissioner of the Taining Army.

sentences.zh: 張弘信通檢山東，專以多得民間物力為功，督責苛急。

translations.literal: Zhang Hongxin as general inspector of Shandong took as his merit obtaining much civilian property and pressed collection harshly.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongxin, as general inspector of Shandong, made his merit obtaining much civilian property and pressed collection harshly.

sentences.zh: 永元面責弘信曰：「朝廷以差調不均，立通檢法。

translations.literal: Yongyuan rebuked Hongxin to his face: "The court established the general-inspector law because tax levies were uneven.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan rebuked Hongxin to his face: "The court established the general-inspector law because tax levies were uneven.

sentences.zh: 今使者所至，以殘酷妄加農民田產，箠擊百姓有至死者。

translations.literal: Now the envoy wherever he goes cruelly adds to peasants' fields and property and beats the people, some even to death.
translations.idiomatic: Now wherever the envoy goes he cruelly adds to peasants' fields and property and beats the people, some even to death.

sentences.zh: 市肆賈販貿易有贏虧，田園屋宇利入有多寡，故官子孫閉門自守，使與商賈同處上役，豈立法本意哉。」

translations.literal: Market traders' commerce has profit and loss; fields, gardens, and houses have varying income—so officials' descendants shut their doors and keep to themselves, yet are placed on corvée equal to merchants. Is this the law's original intent?"
translations.idiomatic: Market traders' commerce has profit and loss; fields, gardens, and houses have varying income. Officials' descendants shut their doors and keep to themselves, yet are placed on corvée equal to merchants. Is this the law's original intent?"

sentences.zh: 弘信無以對。

translations.literal: Hongxin had no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxin had no reply.

sentences.zh: 於是棣州賦稅得以實自占。

translations.literal: Thereupon Di Prefecture's tax levies could be reported honestly from actual holdings.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Di Prefecture's tax levies could be reported honestly from actual holdings.

sentences.zh: 遷震武軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military commissioner of Zhenwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Zhenwu Army.

sentences.zh: 大定六年，丁母憂，起複崇義軍節度使，徙順義軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Dading, when his mother died he was recalled from mourning to resume as military commissioner of Chongyi Army and transferred to Shunyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 6, when his mother died he was recalled from mourning to resume as military commissioner of the Chongyi Army and transferred to the Shunyi Army.

sentences.zh: 朔州西境多盜，而猾吏大姓蠹獄訟，暋亂賦役，永元剔其宿奸，百姓安之。

translations.literal: West of Shuozhou there were many bandits, and crafty officials and great clans corrupted lawsuits, resisting tax levies; Yongyuan eliminated their long-standing villains and the people were at peace.
translations.idiomatic: West of Shuozhou there were many bandits, and crafty officials and great clans corrupted lawsuits and resisted tax levies. Yongyuan eliminated their long-standing villains and the people were at peace.

sentences.zh: 坐賣馬與驛人取贏利，及浚州防禦使斡論坐縱孳畜踐民田，俱解職。

translations.literal: He was dismissed for selling horses to post-station men for profit, and for defense commissioner of Jun Prefecture Wolun allowing livestock to trample civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed for selling horses to post-station men for profit, and because Jun Prefecture defense commissioner Wolun allowed livestock to trample civilian fields.

sentences.zh: 頃之，永元起為保大軍節度使，曆昭義、絳陽、震武軍，遷濟南尹、北京副留守。

translations.literal: Before long Yongyuan was recalled as military commissioner of Baoda Army, served as military commissioner of Zhaoyi, Jiangyang, and Zhenwu armies, and was transferred to prefect of Jinan and vice guardian of the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yongyuan was recalled as military commissioner of the Baoda Army, served as military commissioner of the Zhaoyi, Jiangyang, and Zhenwu armies, and was transferred to prefect of Jinan and vice guardian of the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 燈國家婢醜底與咸平人化胡有奸，醜底于主印處紹取印署空紙與化胡，遂寫作永元、甯國生甯日時辰，誣告永元、甯國謀逆。

translations.literal: The state lamp-maiden slave Choudi had an affair with the Xianping man Huahua; Choudi took blank paper stamped with the master's seal from the seal office and gave it to Huahua, who then wrote Yongyuan's and Ningguo's birth dates and hours, falsely accusing them of plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The state lamp-maiden slave Choudi had an affair with the Xianping man Huahua. Choudi took blank paper stamped with the master's seal from the seal office and gave it to Huahua, who then wrote Yongyuan's and Ningguo's birth dates and hours, falsely accusing them of plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 詔有司鞫問，乃醜底意望為良，使化胡為之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to interrogate; it turned out Choudi hoped to become a commoner and had Huahua do it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the relevant offices to interrogate. It turned out Choudi hoped to become a commoner and had Huahua do it.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「化胡與醜底有奸，造作惡言，誣害宗室，化胡斬，醜底處死。」

translations.literal: The sovereign said: "Huahua had an affair with Choudi and fabricated wicked words to harm the imperial clan—Huahua is to be beheaded and Choudi executed."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign said, "Huahua had an affair with Choudi and fabricated wicked words to harm the imperial clan. Huahua is to be beheaded and Choudi executed."

sentences.zh: 改興中尹，為彰德軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was changed to prefect of Xingzhong and made military commissioner of Zhangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to prefect of Xingzhong and made military commissioner of the Zhangde Army.

sentences.zh: 卒官，年五十一。

translations.literal: He died in office at age fifty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office at age fifty-one.

sentences.zh: 喪過中都，遣使致祭，賻銀三百兩、彩十端、絹百匹。

translations.literal: When the funeral passed through the Central Capital envoys were sent to offer sacrifice; condolence gifts were three hundred taels of silver, ten bolts of colored silk, and a hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: When the funeral passed through the Central Capital envoys were sent to offer sacrifice. Condolence gifts were three hundred taels of silver, ten bolts of colored silk, and a hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 永元曆典大籓，多知民間利害，所至稱治，相、棣、順義政跡尤著，其民並為立祠。

translations.literal: Yongyuan governed several great prefectures and knew much of civilian benefit and harm; wherever he went he was called well governed; his administration in Xiang, Di, and Shunyi was especially notable, and the people all erected shrines for him.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan governed several great prefectures and knew much of civilian benefit and harm. Wherever he went he was called well governed. His administration in Xiang, Di, and Shunyi was especially notable, and the people all erected shrines for him.

sentences.zh: 兗妻烏延氏，正隆六年坐與奴有奸，海陵殺之。

translations.literal: Yan's wife the Wuyan clan—in the sixth year of Zhenglong was convicted of adultery with a slave; Hailing killed her.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's wife of the Wuyan clan—in Zhenglong 6 was convicted of adultery with a slave. Hailing killed her.

sentences.zh: 其弟南京兵馬副都指揮使習泥烈私于族弟屋謀魯之妻，屋謀魯之奴謀欲執習泥烈，習泥烈乃殺其奴。

translations.literal: His younger brother Nanjing deputy commander-in-chief of horse and foot forces Xini Lie privately had relations with his clan younger brother Wumoulu's wife; Wumoulu's slave plotted to seize Xini Lie, and Xini Lie therefore killed the slave.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother, Nanjing deputy commander-in-chief of horse and foot forces Xini Lie, privately had relations with his clan younger brother Wumoulu's wife. Wumoulu's slave plotted to seize Xini Lie, and Xini Lie therefore killed the slave.

sentences.zh: 海陵聞之，遂殺習泥烈。

translations.literal: Hailing heard of it and then killed Xini Lie.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing heard of it and then killed Xini Lie.

sentences.zh: 兗子阿合，大定中為符寶祗候，俄遷同知定武軍節度使。

translations.literal: Yan's son Ahe, in the Dading period was keeper of the seals attendant, and soon transferred to concurrent vice military commissioner of Dingwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's son Ahe, in the Dading period was keeper of the seals attendant, and soon transferred to concurrent vice military commissioner of the Dingwu Army.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「汝歲秩未滿，朕念乃祖乃父為汝遷官，勿為不善，當盡心學之。」

translations.literal: The sovereign said: "Your years in rank are not yet full; I think of your grandfather and father in promoting you—do not do what is not good; you must study with all your heart."
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign said, "Your years in rank are not yet full. I think of your grandfather and father in promoting you. Do not do what is not good; you must study with all your heart."

sentences.zh: 襄本名永慶，海陵母弟。

translations.literal: Xiang's original name was Yongqing, Hailing's younger brother by the same mother.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang was born Yongqing, Hailing's younger brother by the same mother.

sentences.zh: 為輔國上將軍。

translations.literal: He was made general who assists the state.
translations.idiomatic: He was made general who assists the state.

sentences.zh: 卒，天德二年，追封衛王，再贈司徒。

translations.literal: He died; in the second year of Tiande posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, again given the posthumous office of grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: He died. In Tiande 2 he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wei and again given the posthumous office of grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 大定二十二年，追降銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Dading posthumously reduced to silver-green grand master of splendid happiness.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 22 he was posthumously reduced to silver-green grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 子和尚封應國公，賜名樂善。

translations.literal: Son Heshang was enfeoffed as Duke of Ying and given the name Leshan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Heshang was enfeoffed as Duke of Ying and given the name Leshan.

sentences.zh: 左宣徽使許霖之子知彰與和尚鬥爭，其母妃命家奴捽入淩辱之，使人曳霖至第毆詈之。

translations.literal: Left Palace Commissioner Xu Lin's son Zhizhang quarreled with Heshang; his mother the princess consort ordered household slaves to drag him in and humiliate him, and had men drag Lin to her residence and beat and revile him.
translations.idiomatic: Left Palace Commissioner Xu Lin's son Zhizhang quarreled with Heshang. His mother the princess consort ordered household slaves to drag him in and humiliate him, and had men drag Lin to her residence to beat and revile him.

sentences.zh: 明日，霖訴於朝。

translations.literal: The next day Lin complained at court.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Lin complained at court.

sentences.zh: 詔大興尹蕭玉、左丞良弼、權御史大夫張忠輔、左司員外郎王全雜治，妃杖一百，殺其家奴為首者，餘決杖有差。

translations.literal: An edict had Daxing prefect Xiao Yu, left vice director Liangbi, acting censor-in-chief Zhang Zhongfu, and left department outer section director Wang Quan conduct a joint investigation; the princess consort was beaten a hundred times, the leading household slave was killed, and the rest received beatings of varying severity.
translations.idiomatic: An edict had Daxing prefect Xiao Yu, left vice director Liangbi, acting censor-in-chief Zhang Zhongfu, and left department outer section director Wang Quan investigate jointly. The princess consort was beaten a hundred times, the leading household slave was killed, and the rest received beatings of varying severity.

sentences.zh: 霖嘗跪於妃前，失大臣體，及所訴有妄，笞二十。

translations.literal: Lin had once knelt before the princess consort, losing a great minister's dignity, and what he reported had falsehoods—he was beaten twenty times.
translations.idiomatic: Lin had once knelt before the princess consort, losing a great minister's dignity, and what he reported had falsehoods. He was beaten twenty times.

sentences.zh: 大定間，家奴小僧月一妄言和尚熟寢之次有異征，襄妃僧酷以為信然，召日者李端卜之。

translations.literal: During the Dading period the household slave Xiaoseng Yueyi falsely said that when Heshang was in deep sleep there were strange signs; Xiang's consort and the monk Ku believed it and summoned the day-selector Li Duan to divine.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dading period the household slave Xiaoseng Yueyi falsely said that when Heshang was in deep sleep there were strange signs. Xiang's consort and the monk Ku believed it and summoned the day-selector Li Duan to divine.

sentences.zh: 端雲當為天子，司天張友直亦雲當大貴。

translations.literal: Duan said he would become Son of Heaven; Director of Astronomy Zhang Youzhi also said he would become greatly honored.
translations.idiomatic: Duan said he would become Son of Heaven. Director of Astronomy Zhang Youzhi also said he would become greatly honored.

sentences.zh: 家奴李添壽上變。

translations.literal: The household slave Li Tianshou reported the change.
translations.idiomatic: The household slave Li Tianshou reported the change.

sentences.zh: 僧酷、和尚下吏驗問有狀，皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Ku, Heshang, and the others were put under officials and interrogated; the case was substantiated and all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ku, Heshang, and the others were put under officials and interrogated. The case was substantiated and all were executed.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕嘗痛海陵翦滅宗族。

translations.literal: The sovereign said: "I once grieved that Hailing exterminated the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign said, "I once grieved that Hailing exterminated the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 今和尚所為如此，欲貸其罪，則妖妄誤惑愚民者，便以為真，不可不滅。

translations.literal: Now Heshang's conduct is like this; if I pardon his crime, then those who delude the foolish people with sorcery and falsehood will be taken as true—it cannot be spared.
translations.idiomatic: Now Heshang's conduct is like this. If I pardon his crime, then those who delude the foolish people with sorcery and falsehood will be taken as true. It cannot be spared.

sentences.zh: 朕于此子，蓋不得已也。」

translations.literal: In this son of mine I am compelled."
translations.idiomatic: In this son of mine I am compelled."

sentences.zh: 傷閔者久之。

translations.literal: He grieved in pity for a long while.
translations.idiomatic: He grieved in pity for a long while.

sentences.zh: 袞本名蒲甲，亦作蒲家，桀驚強悍。

translations.literal: Gun's original name was Pujia, also written Pujia; he was fierce, startled, strong, and overbearing.
translations.idiomatic: Gun was born Pujia, also written Pujia. He was fierce, startled, strong, and overbearing.

sentences.zh: 海陵不喜其為人。

translations.literal: Hailing did not like his conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing did not like his conduct.

sentences.zh: 初為輔國上將軍。

translations.literal: Initially he was general who assists the state.
translations.idiomatic: Initially he was general who assists the state.

sentences.zh: 天德初，加特進，封王，為吏部尚書，判大宗正事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiande he was given extraordinary promotion, enfeoffed as prince, made Minister of Personnel, and Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiande he was given extraordinary promotion, enfeoffed as prince, made minister of personnel, and director of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 坐語禁中起居狀，兵部侍郎蕭恭首問，護衛張九具言之。

translations.literal: He was convicted for speaking of affairs within the forbidden precinct; Vice Minister of War Xiao Gong was the first to question him, and guard Zhang Jiu stated it in full.
translations.idiomatic: He was convicted for speaking of affairs within the forbidden precinct. Vice Minister of War Xiao Gong was the first to question him, and guard Zhang Jiu stated it in full.

sentences.zh: 海陵親問。

translations.literal: Hailing questioned him in person.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing questioned him in person.

sentences.zh: 恭奪官解職，張九對不以實，特處死，袞與翰林學士承旨宗秀、護衛麻吉、小底王之章皆決杖有差。

translations.literal: Gong was stripped of office and dismissed; Zhang Jiu's answers were not according to fact and he was specially executed; Gun together with Hanlin Academician Director Zong Xiu, guard Maji, and attendant Wang Zhizhang all received beatings of varying severity.
translations.idiomatic: Gong was stripped of office and dismissed. Zhang Jiu's answers were not according to fact and he was specially executed. Gun together with Hanlin academician director Zong Xiu, guard Maji, and attendant Wang Zhizhang all received beatings of varying severity.

sentences.zh: 海陵自是愈忌之。

translations.literal: From this Hailing resented him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: After this Hailing resented him ever more deeply.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授猛安。

translations.literal: Before long he was granted a meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was granted a meng'an command.

sentences.zh: 及遷中都，道中以蒲家為西京留守。

translations.literal: When he was transferred to the Central Capital, on the road he appointed Pujia Western Capital prefect.
translations.idiomatic: When he was transferred to the Central Capital, on the road he appointed Pujia Western Capital prefect.

sentences.zh: 西京兵馬完顏謨盧瓦與蒲家有舊，同在西京，遂相往來。

translations.literal: Western Capital horse-and-foot forces commander Wanyan Moluwa was old friends with Pujia; both were in the Western Capital and therefore associated with each other.
translations.idiomatic: Western Capital commander Wanyan Moluwa was old friends with Pujia. Both were in the Western Capital and therefore associated with each other.

sentences.zh: 蒲家嘗以玉帶遺之。

translations.literal: Pujia once gave him a jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: Pujia once presented him with a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 蒲家稱謨盧瓦驍勇不減尉遲敬德。

translations.literal: Pujia said Moluwa's martial valor was no less than Yuchi Jingde's.
translations.idiomatic: Pujia said Moluwa's martial valor was no less than Yuchi Jingde's.

sentences.zh: 編修官圓福奴之妻與蒲家姻戚，圓福奴嘗戒蒲家曰：「大王名太彰著，宜少謙晦。」

translations.literal: Compiler Yuan Funu's wife was related to Pujia by marriage; Yuan Funu once admonished Pujia: "Your princely name is too conspicuous—you should be somewhat more modest and restrained."
translations.idiomatic: Compiler Yuan Funu's wife was related to Pujia by marriage. Yuan Funu once admonished Pujia, "Your princely name is too conspicuous. You should be somewhat more modest and restrained."

sentences.zh: 蒲家心知海陵忌之，嘗召日者問休咎。

translations.literal: Pujia knew in his heart that Hailing resented him and once summoned a day-selector to ask about fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Pujia knew in his heart that Hailing resented him and once summoned a day-selector to ask about fortune and misfortune.

sentences.zh: 家奴喝里知海陵疑蒲家，乃上變告之，言與謨盧瓦等謀反，嘗召日者問天命。

translations.literal: The household slave Heli knew Hailing suspected Pujia and therefore reported the change, saying he plotted rebellion with Moluwa and others and had once summoned a day-selector to ask about the Mandate of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The household slave Heli knew Hailing suspected Pujia and therefore reported the change, saying he plotted rebellion with Moluwa and others and had once summoned a day-selector to ask about the Mandate of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫高楨、刑部侍郎耶律慎須呂就西京鞫之，無狀。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Gao Zhen and Vice Minister of Punishments Yelü Shenxulü went to the Western Capital to interrogate; no case was substantiated.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Gao Zhen and Vice Minister of Punishments Yelü Shenxulü went to the Western Capital to interrogate. No case was substantiated.

sentences.zh: 海陵怒，使使者往械蒲家等至中都，不復究問，斬之於市。

translations.literal: Hailing was angry and sent envoys to shackle Pujia and the others to the Central Capital; he no longer pursued further inquiry and executed them in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing was furious and sent envoys to shackle Pujia and the others to the Central Capital. He pursued no further inquiry and executed them in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 謨盧瓦、圓福奴並日者皆淩遲處死。

translations.literal: Moluwa, Yuan Funu, and the day-selectors were all executed by slow slicing.
translations.idiomatic: Moluwa, Yuan Funu, and the day-selectors were all executed by slow slicing.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：金議禮制度，班爵祿，正刑法，治曆明時，行天子之事，成一代之典，杲、宗幹經始之功多矣。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Jin deliberated ritual systems, ranked stipends and salaries, rectified punishments and law, regulated the calendar and clarified the seasons, performed the Son of Heaven's affairs, and completed the institutions of an age—the pioneering merit of Gao and Zong Gan was great indeed.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Jin deliberated ritual systems, ranked stipends and salaries, rectified punishments and law, regulated the calendar and clarified the seasons, performed the Son of Heaven's affairs, and completed the institutions of an age. The pioneering merit of Gao and Zong Gan was great indeed.

sentences.zh: 杲子宗義為海陵所殺，宗幹之後又不幸而有海陵，故其子孫之昌熾既鮮，而亦不免於僇辱焉。

translations.literal: Gao's son Zongyi was killed by Hailing; Zong Gan's line was again unfortunate in having Hailing, so their descendants' flourishing was already rare and they could not escape humiliation and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Gao's son Zongyi was killed by Hailing. Zong Gan's line was again unfortunate in having Hailing, so their descendants' flourishing was already rare and they could not escape humiliation and punishment.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢而下，宗臣世家與國匹休者，何其少歟。

translations.literal: From Qin and Han downward, how few are the imperial-clan great houses that share weal and woe with the state!
translations.idiomatic: From Qin and Han downward, how few are the imperial-clan great houses that share weal and woe with the state!

sentences.zh: 君子于此，可以觀世變矣。

translations.literal: The gentleman observing this may discern the changes of the age.
